import numpy as np

def quantize_kv_cache(kv_cache, bits=8):
    q_max = 2**(bits - 1) - 1  # 127 for INT8
    scales = np.max(np.abs(kv_cache), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    scales = np.clip(scales, 1e-10, None)
    quantized = np.round(kv_cache / scales * q_max)
    quantized = np.clip(quantized, -q_max - 1, q_max).astype(np.int8)
    return quantized, scales
